## Summary

Describe the user-visible and scientific effect.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit/contract tests added or updated
- [ ] CPU reference behavior stated
- [ ] Accelerator differential gate passed or not applicable
- [ ] Source frames remain read-only and outputs use new/no-replace paths
- [ ] Solver result distinguishes `SEED` from `SOLVED`
- [ ] Drizzle science/weight/coverage evidence updated or not applicable
- [ ] No personal paths, proprietary code, raw frames, catalogs, or secrets added
- [ ] Documentation/recipe and changelog updated

## Evidence

List exact commands, fixtures, numerical tolerances, and retained reports. Do not attach non-redistributable astronomical data.
